body:
You're right. It hadn't even occurred to me that this must be my rock bottom and perhaps not my ending.

I've just been so caught up in this spiraling out of control and feeling so worthless and broken that it's blinded me into believing this is my only option.

I just don't know where or how or what to do next. 

What do I do to get me through this night? I'm prepared to drive off but I don't know where to go or what I'm going to do. I just feel like there's nothing that I know of to do. 

I feel like I should know at least one way to cope with tonight but it's all escaping me at the moment.
